Very efficient neighbour hood super market. Stock with every household item and groceries. Prizes are good. With very nice staff willing to help at any given time.
Almost all house hold things are available here. No need to go other places. But no discount on MRP. Service was good. Better to carry change. Card swipe available from 250/-.
